subject.title: tools.exec.approvalRunningNoticeMs is documented but rejected by the 2026.3.24 config schema

question: Should maintainers adopt/rebase the open fork repair, or close it and land a narrow same-repo replacement for the schema-only fix?
rationale: The issue is valid and small, but an open conflicting fork PR claims the exact fix and is not maintainer-editable, so automation should not open a duplicate repair without a maintainer routing choice.

options.title: Replace with narrow same-repo repair
options.body: Close or supersede the fork PR as the source, then land the schema-only change with focused config-schema tests and no stale daemon changes.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork PR
options.body: A maintainer can manually rebase the fork head, remove unrelated stale changes, obtain proof, and merge that branch if it becomes clean.

options.title: Wait for fork author
options.body: Leave this issue open and hold new repair work until the fork author updates the conflicting uneditable branch.

recommendation.title: Replace with narrow same-repo repair
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the fork PR as the source, then land the schema-only change with focused config-schema tests and no stale daemon changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The mismatch originates in steipete's documented config behavior commit, and the fix is a core config-schema compatibility cleanup.
